question: The area of a square is 900 cm². Its perimeter is equal to the perimeter of a regular hexagon. What is the area (in cm2) of the hexagon?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Side of **square** = √900 = 30 cm.

Perimeter of **square** = 4 × 30 = 120 cm.

Side of **hexagon** = 120 ÷ 6 = 20 cm.

Area of **hexagon** = 6 × (√3/4) × 20² = 600√3 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 600√3 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Area of **square** = 900 cm². Perimeter of **square** = Perimeter of **hexagon**.

**Formula Used:** Area of square = a² | Perimeter of square = 4a | Perimeter of hexagon = 6s | Area of regular hexagon = (3√3/2)s².

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59a05731b58a628a3ac3bf8e855fe2b4a4fb881773799d25fcd41e5a0332e7e8.png] 

⇒ Let side of **square** be a.

⇒ a² = 900 ⇒ a = 30 cm.

⇒ Perimeter of **square** = 4 × 30 = 120 cm.

⇒ Let side of **regular hexagon** be s.

⇒ 6s = 120 ⇒ s = 20 cm.

⇒ Area of **hexagon** = (3√3 ÷ 2) × (20)²

⇒ Area = (3√3 ÷ 2) × 400 = 3√3 × 200 = 600√3 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 600√3 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Regular Hexagon Properties

A **regular hexagon** is composed of 6 **equilateral triangles**. Its area is 6 × (√3/4)s².

Square Properties

For a **square** with side a, the diagonal is a√2 and the area is a² or (diagonal²)/2.

Perimeter Comparison

If the **perimeter** of different regular polygons is the same, the one with more sides will have a larger **area**.</p
